title: Board games
description: Having travelled extensively abroad, particularly while working for 5 years in London (United Kingdom), I have always found board games to be an ideal and natural way to meet new people and new communities, while also expanding the range of games I have had the opportunity to experience. From simple card games to complex board games, as well as role-playing games such as Dungeons & Dragons, I have a great affection for all these shared moments.

image.alt: Photograph of a summer Dungeons & Dragons session in a London park.
